description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of automated tests for Git's 'for-each-ref' command, verifying its handling of various options and outputs, including ref filters, formatting, sorting, and ref state checking.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success, runs a series of commands, and reports the outcome.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, verifies failure.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output files.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after test completion.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisite features (e.g., GPG support).

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit with specified message or content.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
